requiredFindings.title: Retain the recognized results in detected evidence
requiredFindings.detail: The accepted plan requires detected evidence to contain the recognized results with their evidence. DetectedEvidence retains only Source, provenance and evidence tuples, dropping assurance and all effects. This loses information precisely when a setting is not proposed. For example, two partial Next.js recognitions with identical config bytes/root but pages/a.tsx versus pages/b.tsx produce the same returned evidence: entry proposals are suppressed, config evidence and unresolved choices are identical, and the same ignore directory is proposed. The detected route entries disappear. Test globs also have no representation in the returned payload. The M4 renderer cannot present the detected results from RecommendationEvidenceV1 alone.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Retain each complete recognized result, or an equivalent lossless internal representation, with its unit and provenance. Keep detected unit-relative effects separate from projected project settings. Add a control showing that differing detected entry effects remain visible when partial recognition or explicit configuration suppresses entry proposals; include assurance and test-glob retention.

requiredFindings.title: Return resolved configurations for each choice effect, not only their digests
requiredFindings.detail: The accepted plan defines the effect of each choice as the resolved configuration with and without each proposed setting. round_trip computes a ResolvedConfigurationV1 but discards it, retaining only its digest and the selected path list. RecommendationEvidenceV1 likewise retains only base_digest. These opaque hashes do not provide the resolved configurations required by the plan or let the future renderer inspect the actual before/after values and provenance. Current tests recompute the resolutions outside the returned evidence and compare digests, so they do not establish this payload requirement.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Retain the actual base resolved configuration and the resolved configuration for each admitted proposed setting, or equivalent complete resolved-value evidence, while keeping digests as useful identities. Ensure the returned before/after records equal actual resolve outputs, including applying none; preserve carrier fields and the read-only behavior. Update the scope and tests to assert the returned effect records, rather than only recomputing and comparing digests.
